messages.subject: Problem with 'verbose' argument in FirmaModel
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to run some old code (last spring), and I am getting an error
in the function 'FirmaModel' when I try to manually set the verbose
option. If I leave that option out, then the function runs with no
problem (the defining of the R object linking to it, haven't rerun the
calculations...)
Best,
Elizabeth

> verbose<- -3
> firmaTissue <- FirmaModel(plmTissue,verbose=verbose)
Error in list("FirmaModel(plmTissue, verbose = verbose)" =
<environment>, :

[2007-10-31 14:14:17] Exception: Unknown arguments: verbose
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Unknown arguments: ", argsStr)
at throw("Unknown arguments: ", argsStr)
at Model(dataSet = dataSet, ...)
at extend(Model(dataSet = dataSet, ...), "UnitModel")
at UnitModel(..., tags = tags)
at extend(UnitModel(..., tags = tags), "FirmaModel", .plm = rmaPlm,
summaryMet
at FirmaModel(plmTissue, verbose = verbose)
> firmaTissue <- FirmaModel(plmTissue)

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Problem with 'verbose' argument in FirmaModel
parts:
Hi. You're right. The 'verbose' arguments are currently only taken by
methods not constructors.

There is currently no way to set the verbose for an object (like you
tried) nor globally for all aroma.affymetrix actions. One redesign
could be to let the verbose argument default to a verbose field of the
object which in turn defaults to a global verbose. However, this far
this is just thoughts.

Cheers

Henrik
